changes.reason: The page now maps three user questions to distinct request purposes and requires a pinned opportunity-search Run before building a batch.
The proposal summary now presents evidence according to the selected question instead of treating every Screening Run as one goal search.
Representative-row labels changed with the mode presentation but do not alter the contract or evidence-lineage claims.
The stylesheet supports the three-mode layout without adding a separately teachable behavior or boundary.
Generated types expose purpose and source_run_id, while the unrelated contract exercises retain their existing field and union assumptions.
OpenAPI gained the v7 Screening shape without changing the Decision Activity union or migration examples taught elsewhere.
The service assigns question-specific scoring evidence and builds a batch from the selected points of a validated saved goal-search Run.
New requests require purpose and enforce distinct combinations of goals, source_run_id, support policy, and batch definition.
Domain scoring now supports the question-specific evidence selected by the application service, with no separate glossary boundary.
Batch tests now prove selection from the selected points of the pinned saved Run rather than independently regenerated candidates.
Fixtures provide the new request purpose but Candidate revision and digest safety assertions remain unchanged.
External-task fixtures now identify a goal search, while the task-adapter claim itself is unchanged.
The hot-rolling fixture supplies purpose without changing its task-specific contract expectations.
Objective execution fixtures opt into goal search, but Objective Definition semantics tested by the lesson are unchanged.
Project tests cover purpose-aware saved Runs without altering archive, restore, purge, or shared-definition ownership.
Geometry tests distinguish support-distance mapping from objective-ranked opportunity search across the same Design Space.
Strategy tests supply the required purpose while the registered strategy behavior remains unchanged.
The end-to-end backend fixture names a goal search without changing the previously taught identity and evidence boundaries.
The architecture source now defines the three questions and makes the saved goal-search Run the batch evidence source.
The baseline names the three current modes and therefore supports the new current concept rather than a future capability.
The E2E test fixes the visible questions, source_run_id request, evidence reuse, and reopening behavior for an old purpose-less Run.
